content: Windows dictation injection (win-text-inject crate writeup + OpenWhispr #829, FluidVoice #940, Handy #502, all 2025-2026): every surveyed dictation tool does save-clipboard/paste/sleep/restore and all timer-based restores race the target's async clipboard read — guess short and target pastes the PREVIOUS clipboard, guess long and user waits (Handy #502 open since 2025-12). Correct signal is delayed render: SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, NULL) promise + WM_RENDERFORMAT counting; one render is not enough (Chromium probes then reads — need ~400ms quiet settle); clipboard managers consume the promise pre-paste (need baseline + timer fallback). Transcripts must carry opt-out formats (ExcludeClipboardContentFromMonitorProcessing, Clipboard Viewer Ignore, CanIncludeInClipboardHistory=0, CanUploadToCloudClipboard=0). Elevated targets fail SILENTLY under UIPI — check integrity level first and report honestly. Physically held modifiers corrupt synthesized chords — release held modifiers, never re-press. SetClipboardData returns NULL on success for a promise and last-error is stale (~1 in 4 pastes). SendInput fallback: KEYEVENTF_UNICODE chunked 256; VS Code: Shift+Insert broken, use Ctrl+V; terminals need Ctrl+Shift+V. SendInput events should carry dwExtraInfo tag so own hooks can filter.
